reserveReview.rationale: Independently verified 2026-10-02: the dated mTBILL historical issuer API reports USTB $71.638 million, BUIDL $4.812 million and total equity $76.4537698558 million. The exact total and October 1 portfolio checkpoint match the signed SAVE payload; its IPFS root matches the issuer-authorized registry publication at 2026-10-01T13:49:47Z. Canonical payload hash and ECDSA signature were reproduced. Composition is admitted as an official dated issuer disclosure, separately from financial assurance. Weights divide rounded named positions by the exact reported total and retain the entire unidentified residual without renormalization. Base and Ethereum exposure, provider mapping, all-root liabilities and pending-redemption reconciliation remain unresolved; the self-signed report grants no independent financial assurance. The latest dashboard endpoint remains September 18 and is not date-bumped.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas SAVE-linked historical mTBILL portfolio checkpoint 2026-10-01T10:00; rounded USD-million positions divided by exact reported equity 76.4537698558, with explicit unclassified residual
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Curated October 1 weights, composition clock and $3,769.8558 unclassified remainder (0.004930895895793434%) are unchanged. Source-maintenance review 2026-10-19 accepts v2 joined provenance: current Ethereum registry discovery authenticates an immutable SAVE checkpoint/date and aggregate; only the official historical API at that exact signed hour supplies named holdings, reconciled within $0.01. The observed October 16 book totals $78,609,324.3164, with USTB $73,784,000, BUIDL $4,819,000 and a single $6,324.3164 unknown remainder including the $1,081.0803 Ethereum/Base chain gap. These are live-source research receipts, not refreshed curated weights. Signed rows do not include composition, and empty signed liabilities do not prove zero obligations. UnixFS DAG-PB root verification, authorized publisher and original checkpoint chronology are required; document expiry/publication cannot extend the unchanged 3-day source or 48-hour fetch caps. Latest remains September 18; by-timestamp data alone cannot date a book. Whole-book custody, beneficial allocation, encumbrances, all-root liabilities and pending-redemption reconciliation remain unresolved. No independent financial assurance, custody shares, supply override or executable redemption capacity is established; stale/mismatched v2 evidence fails closed without renewing the old operational review.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The July 17, 2026 mTBILL final terms name Maerki Baumann & Co. AG as custodian and Ankura Trust Company LLC as security agent, with custody and collateral accounts and agreements applicable. Provider shares, the custody mapping of the issuer-reported USTB/BUIDL wallets, and rehypothecation terms remain unresolved. The inherited segregated status is not newly confirmed by those terms; the custody and collateral agreements themselves are needed to renew that claim. Security arrangements do not confer direct ownership of underlying assets; the 2026 prospectus retains qualified subordination, limited recourse, and enforcement-risk warnings.
